slides.texte_overlay:
the quiet details people
notice when they meet you

the way you enter

people read your energy the moment you walk in. a calm, unhurried entrance with relaxed shoulders tells everyone you're comfortable before you say a single word.

how warm your eyes are

meeting someone's eyes with a soft, warm look feels like real interest. holding it one second longer than usual quietly tells them you're glad they're there.

how curious you seem

people sense genuine curiosity within seconds, and it grows when you feed your mind a little every day. a curious mind shows up in your face before you say anything at all.
slides.texte_sophia:
how curious you seem

people notice curiosity before i speak. i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, a planet or a painting, and it shows in my face and in how i listen.

slides.texte_overlay:
the pace of your voice

a calm, slightly slower voice makes people lean in and trust you. rushing your words, on the other hand, quietly signals nerves even when you feel completely fine.

what your hands are doing

open, relaxed hands look honest and friendly. hands hidden in pockets or fidgeting with a phone can make people feel a little more guarded around you without knowing why.
